base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: single background scene for an offline spot-the-difference game. Input image: STYLE/QUALITY REFERENCE ONLY, showing two comparison pictures. Create ONE coherent single photograph, NOT a pair, NOT split-screen. Match its convincing photographic quality, luxury cruise mood, actual materials and rich scene depth. Recompose as a LANDSCAPE 3:2 image at 1536x1024 so the whole scene can be seen on a small phone. Eye-level, inviting sunny cruise-ship pool deck; gleaming white curved upper ship deck and a shaded teak poolside bar in the upper right; open blue ocean and sky in the upper left; bright turquoise pool in the center/right; warm teak decking foreground. Distribute large clear game objects with space between them: a cream sun parasol in the upper left, an orange life ring attached to left-middle railing, two blue-cushioned loungers at middle-left beside the pool, a potted palm with red hibiscus blooms at the far left foreground, a beach ball floating in the right half of pool, shiny pool ladder along right edge. In the lower foreground a comfortably close lounge chair draped with a blue-and-white striped towel; a woven straw sunhat with a dark blue ribbon rests on it, fully visible, not cut off. At lower right a round teak side table with one closed blue book, one pair of black sunglasses and one tall orange tropical drink with pink paper umbrella and orange slice. Make these table objects separately legible and not overlapping. A small folded coral towel on one middle-distance lounger. Warm natural daylight, believable contact shadows, detailed sparkling water, crisp realistic fabrics, polished metal, attractive well-kept cruise ship. Keep all important objects within frame. No people, no faces or smiling sun, no cartoons, no illustration, no labels, no numbers, no text, no UI, no collage. A beautifully photographed real place, not a flat asset arrangement.
